# WoW AndroWhere 0.4.1

First release from this fork, based on WoW Foreverywhere 0.4.0.

- **App updates come from this fork.** The in-app updater now checks this repository's releases, and **Source code on GitHub** opens it.

## Install

Download **WoW-Foreverywhere.apk** below. If you installed an earlier version from this page, it installs as an update and keeps your settings, saved login and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
